buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. Scope • The selected bidder shall execute digital display services strictly as per the Scope of Work, Technical S pecifications, approved BOQ and work order. • The Buyer may issue an approved event layout/schedule after award. The bidder shall coordinate its e xecution accordingly. 2. Bidder Eligibility / Experience

• The bidder should be a legally registered entity/firm/company capable of providing event production, e xhibition, AV/display and/or media coverage services. • The bidder should have relevant experience in similar seminar, conference, exhibition, expo or instituti onal events. Documentary proof such as work orders/completion certificates/invoices may be requested. • Where the Buyer specifies a minimum financial/experience criterion, the same shall be inserted in the f inal bid; avoid unnecessarily restrictive brand-specific conditions. 3. Site Visit / Pre-Bid Clarification • Bidders are advised to assess the venue, access, loading/unloading arrangements, power availability, c eiling/rigging restrictions and exhibition layout before quoting. • Any site-specific assumptions shall be clearly stated in the bid. After award, the bidder shall not claim additional payment for requirements reasonably inferable from the published specifications. 4. Mobilisation & Installation • The bidder shall mobilise equipment/materials and complete installation as per the schedule approved by the Buyer/venue. • All testing and rehearsal shall be completed before the start of the programme. • The bidder shall provide adequate standby personnel during critical programme hours. 5. Content, Artwork & Approvals • Buyer-approved logos, artwork, presentations and exhibitor information shall be used only for the even t. • The bidder shall not publish, sell, reuse or commercially exploit event photographs, videos, presentatio ns or branding without prior written permission. 6. Equipment & Substitution • Equipment offered shall meet or exceed the minimum technical specifications. • Any substitution due to breakdown or availability shall be of equal or better specification and shall req uire Buyer approval where it materially affects the output. 7. Performance & Service Levels • The bidder shall respond immediately to technical faults during live programme hours. • Critical display/AV faults should be attended to within 10 minutes of notification and restored as soon a s reasonably possible. • Repeated failure attributable to inadequate equipment/manpower may be treated as non-performance and may attract deductions/other contractual remedies as permitted by the tender conditions. 8. Intellectual Property & Usage Rights • Upon payment, the Buyer shall receive the right to use the commissioned photographs, videos, graphi cs and event documentation for official, archival, promotional and digital communication purposes, subject to the tender/work order. • Third-party music, stock footage, fonts or other copyrighted materials, if used, shall be properly licens ed by the bidder. 9. Confidentiality & Data Protection • The bidder shall maintain confidentiality of non-public event information, recordings, presentations and participant information obtained during the assignment. • No participant contact details or personal data shall be collected or used except as expressly authorise d by the Buyer. 10. Venue Damage & Housekeeping • The bidder shall take reasonable care of venue property. Damage caused by the bidder’s personnel or equipment shall be repaired/compensated as determined under the contract. • The bidder shall remove all temporary structures, packaging and waste generated by its work. 11. Taxes & Statutory Compliance • Rates shall be quoted inclusive/exclusive of taxes exactly as required in the BOQ/portal. Applicable GS T and statutory levies shall be handled as per prevailing law and tender instructions. • The bidder shall comply with applicable labour, safety, electrical and statutory requirements for its dep loyed personnel. 12. Manpower • All deployed personnel shall be adequately trained, professionally dressed and identifiable during the e vent. • The bidder shall be responsible for wages, insurance, statutory dues and conduct of its personnel. 13. Subcontracting • Subcontracting/outsourcing of material portions of the work shall not be permitted without prior writte n approval of the Buyer, except routine specialist services expressly allowed in the bid. • The main bidder shall remain fully responsible for performance of all approved subcontracted activities . 14. Payment • Payment shall be made against satisfactory completion/acceptance and submission of invoice and req uired supporting documents, in accordance with the final work order and applicable procurement rules. • Post-event media deliverables, where separately priced, may be linked to acceptance of those delivera

bles. 15. Liquidated Damages / Deductions • For delay or non-performance attributable to the bidder, deductions/liquidated damages may be applie d as specified in the final tender/work order, subject to applicable procurement rules. • No deduction shall be imposed for delays caused by the Buyer, venue, force majeure or other events d emonstrably beyond the bidder’s control, subject to contract conditions. 16. Cancellation / Force Majeure • The Buyer may modify, postpone or cancel the event subject to the terms of the final contract/work or der and applicable procurement rules. • Force majeure shall be dealt with as per the standard contract conditions applicable to the procuremen t. 17. Bid Validity • Bid validity: [90/120] days from the bid submission deadline, or as specified in the portal/tender sched ule. 18. Performance Security / EMD • EMD, performance security, exemption and related conditions shall be as specified by the Buyer and th e applicable procurement portal/rules. Amounts should be inserted only after confirmation by the procurin g entity. 19. Award & Contract • The successful bidder shall execute the work order/contract and comply with all published tender condi tions. In case of conflict, the order of precedence shall be as stated in the final tender document/portal ter ms. 20. Buyer’s Right to Inspection • The Buyer may inspect equipment/materials and review the bidder’s execution readiness before and d uring the event. • The bidder shall promptly rectify any deficiency identified during inspection. 21. Dispute Resolution & Jurisdiction • Disputes shall be handled under the dispute-resolution mechanism and jurisdiction specified in the Buy er’s standard procurement/contract conditions. Insert the applicable location and governing clause before i ssue. 22. Bidder Undertaking The bidder confirms that it has examined the Scope of Work, Technical Specifications, venue-related requir ements and ATC, and agrees to provide complete services in accordance with the approved BOQ and contr act conditions. .
